name: metal-ci-native
purpose: Explicit fresh experimental Metal wheel build when exact original reuse is unavailable or inputs changed
reuse: Default to pinned original build-only wheel with unchanged full first-party production/package input set, current dependency verification and fresh installed CPU imports/SDF controls
fresh: Explicit workflow_dispatch native_mode=fresh; never an automatic fallback
retention: Retain current source/license snapshot, original archive/build/consumer records and required native leaves; reuse immutable artifacts by SHA256
terminal_cleanup: Use registered lifecycle finish after actual child exit/wait; apply registry-bound cleanup and preserve failures/reproducer
scope: Experimental Metal build and installed CPU controls only; no graphics/hardware qualification or artifact admission
